title: 第13章 血棺横空上古时代血魔再现第14章 于诸天万界都有布局要征战仙域
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
圣地老祖啊！
圣地内的至高存在，修为境界深不可测。
平日间一直处于沉睡中。
唯有圣地出现巨大危机时，老祖们才会醒来。
如今，老祖们竟悉数醒来，陪着陈长生参观圣地！
见到这一幕的圣地弟子成员。
无一例外。
全都看傻了。
他们倒吸冷气不止，内心惊悚万分。
陈长生到底有什么来头？
竟能让老祖们不惜从沉睡中醒来，陪着参观圣地！
……
时间不长。
那名前往古老遗迹查看情况的长老回来了。
他找了过来。
“果然出事了！”
他神色凝重，声音发沉。
古老遗迹那边，出现了莫名力量，封住了古老遗迹入口。
他没能进到古老遗迹里面。
也看不到古老遗迹里面的景象。

不知圣主和里面长老的情况如何。
“但是情况…不容乐观啊！”
他皱着眉毛说道：“我在遗迹入口那边闻到了非常重的血腥味！”
如果不出意外的话。
圣主和里面的长老，多数可能发生了不测！
“嗯？”
陈长生挑眉，道一圣主出事了？
“那处古老遗迹在哪？”
他开口问道，想过去走一趟。
他还等着道一圣主指点教导李若雪修行呢。
虽然他拥有无敌的力量。
各种逆天功法。
但他真不会指点教导修行。
“不敢麻烦公子！”
一位圣地老祖，急忙说道：“我们过去走一趟就行了，若是我们不行，公子再出手也不迟！”
陈长生出手固然好。
但他们哪里敢随便麻烦陈长生啊！
这可是一位仙人！
不到万不得已。
content_en:
Holy Land Ancestor!
The supreme being in the Holy Land has an unfathomable level of cultivation.
He has been sleeping all day long.
Only when there is a huge crisis in the Holy Land will the ancestors wake up.
Now, all the ancestors have woken up and accompanied Chen Changsheng to visit the Holy Land!
The members of the Holy Land disciples who saw this scene.
Without exception.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
They gasped and felt terrified inside.
What is the background of Chen Changsheng?
How could the ancestors wake up from their slumber and accompany them to visit the holy land!
…
Not long.
The elder who went to the ancient ruins to check the situation came back.
He came over.
"Sure enough, something happened!"
His expression was solemn and his voice was deep.
On the other side of the ancient ruins, an inexplicable force appeared, sealing the entrance to the ancient ruins.
He failed to enter the ancient ruins.
Nor can we see the scene inside the ancient ruins.
I don’t know what the situation is like with the Holy Master and the elders inside.
"But the situation... is not optimistic!"
He frowned and said, "I smelled a very strong smell of blood at the entrance to the ruins!"
If nothing else happens.
Something might have happened to most of the Holy Lord and the elders inside!
"Huh?"
Chen Changsheng raised his eyebrows and said something happened to Holy Master Yi?
"Where is that ancient ruins?"
He asked, wanting to go there for a walk.
He was still waiting for Holy Master Daoyi to teach Li Ruoxue how to practice.
Although he possesses invincible power.
All kinds of heaven-defying techniques.
But he really doesn’t know how to teach and practice.
"Don't dare trouble the young master!"
An ancestor from the Holy Land hurriedly said: "We just need to go over there. If we can't do it, it's not too late for Young Master to take action!"
It would be good for Chen Changsheng to take action.
But how dare they bother Chen Changsheng casually!
This is an immortal!
Not as a last resort.
